senses.gloss: part. pass. דָּגוּל, v. דֶּגֶל.—Nif. נִדְגַּל (denom. of דֶּגֶל) to be divided in troops, arranged. Part. pl. f. נִדְגָּלוֹת those arranged in troops, the hosts of heaven.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2:19">Num. R. s. 2</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Song of Songs 6:4">Cant. VI, 4</cite>) <he>ובמה אתם כנ׳</he> and wherein do ye (Israelites) resemble the angels?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 992:26">Yalk. Cant. 992</cite>.

senses.gloss: to put up a flag, to signalize. Tanḥ., ed. Bub., B’midb. 15 (ref. to Cant. II, 4) ולוי הוא מַדְגִּיל עלי אהבה (Tanḥ. ib. 14; Num. R. l. c. מגדיל) Oh, that He would let the flag of love wave over me!
